title: Input cursor goes to the end - when removing text
body:
Hi,

We have been having this weird issue on our input bar

Whenever you search for something ex. "iphone", and remove a character "ipone", the cursor moves to the very end

You can try it here:
http://robotech.letstango.com

Any assistance would highly be appreciated

comments.body:
For reference to find which version this is using. The site imports: 

* [AlgoliaSearchBundle 4.3.4](http://robotech.letstango.com/js/algoliasearch/internals/frontend/algoliaBundle.min.js)

And it uses:

* [instantsearch.js](http://robotech.letstango.com/js/algoliasearch/instantsearch.js)
* [autocomplete.js](http://robotech.letstango.com/js/algoliasearch/autocomplete.js)

Do we have a version issue?

It appears to be happening on Chrome
@SenenLT Any luck with the new version?
I tried on @SenenLT website, and I can't reproduce the issue anymore. Let's close this one for now.
